title: Who Verifies AI?
description: Anthropic's FlashProve, votes restricting U.S. data centers, setbacks for pro-AI political spending, and two coding-agent acquisitions put verification and accountability in focus.

anthropic-flashprove-provable-inference.topic: Anthropic introduces FlashProve to verify which model actually produced an answer

anthropic-flashprove-provable-inference.verification_scope: TechCrunch and relevant passages of Anthropic's research article, including abstract, introduction, performance and limitations. The technical report and code were not read or reproduced.
